question: If I own both a permanent and an Aura attached to it and both are destroyed at the same time, such as by Akroma's Vengeance, do I decide the order they go into my graveyard?

expected.shortAnswer: Yes: you decide the order; if just the permanent is destroyed, it goes first and the Aura follows after state-based actions.
expected.answer: Say you're the owner of both a permanent and an Aura that's attached to it. If both the permanent and the Aura are destroyed at the same time (by Akroma's Vengeance, for example), you decide the order they're put into your graveyard. If just the enchanted permanent is destroyed, it's put into your graveyard first. Then, after state-based actions are checked, the Aura (which is no longer attached to anything) is put into your graveyard on top of it.

whyHard: Players assume the Aura always goes second, which is true only when the permanent alone is destroyed.
